entries.text: Fact 6: Looking things up never goes well. I shall not be looking things up again.

Day 16: Today, I hoarded a half-croissant, a strip of flatbread, and a bit of grilled onion. Derek’s cousin arrived, and I said nothing. Pino waits. The crown cork was invented in 1892. I landed on rooftops with grace, and on fountains with suspicion. Lists must be complete. Wheels are not to be trusted.
